business_goal: maximize comparable net contribution; do not optimize proxies as revenue
scope: documentation and primary-source verification, no account or database audit

claims.original: bidWon reveals exact final publisher revenue
claims.correction: Event reports the Prebid bid CPM, not settled net session revenue after partner fees and IVT.

claims.original: AdX revenue is mathematically at least max(highest Prebid bid, UPR floor)/1000
claims.correction: Client methods do not establish the eligible losing GAM bid, applied floor and final net settlement for this impression.

claims.original: impressionViewable verifies human traffic and payable revenue
claims.correction: Event certifies the stated visibility condition only; it is neither IVT verdict nor revenue settlement.

claims.original: all click IDs support exact session revenue correction D+1
claims.correction: Need action ownership, supported ID/action path, original recognition, stable identity and compatible actual revenue grain. WBRAID adjustments are not equivalent to GCLID/GBRAID. Aggregate daily exports cannot create exact session amounts.

claims.original: Smart Bidding responds in less than five minutes
claims.correction: Collection, upload acceptance, attribution and bidding reaction have separate latency. Measure each; no guaranteed five-minute learning claim.
Projected finite differences need micros conversion, positive incremental clicks, compatible scenario, incremental revenue uncertainty and observed validation.

claims.original: higher acquisition-aware floor forces buyers to pay more and protects margin
claims.correction: Can reduce fill and revenue. Need partner control, supported GAM targeting, observed cost buckets and one-lever holdout. UPR acq_bucket support not proven.

claims.original: top-of-page bids times competition predicts feed yield; cosine ensures full compliance
claims.correction: Metrics are historical buyer-side statistics. Embeddings aid ranking but do not prove feed eligibility, displayed terms, relevance compliance or RPC.

claims.original: account-level IP blocking can be used
claims.correction: v25 exposes account IP exclusions. Current per-level limits and channel support require verification; no automatic ASN/CIDR exclusion from heuristics.

claims.original: ASN, interaction and Active View make traffic exclusively human
claims.correction: These are imperfect risk signals; measure false positives and mature network deductions.

claims.original: same-domain sendBeacon is not blocked by privacy tools
claims.correction: Same-domain collection may help but consent, browser policy, blockers, network loss and spoofing still apply; require durable receiver receipts.

claims.original: seasonality adjustment is a generic reaction to sell-side RPM
claims.correction: Seasonality adjusts expected conversion rate; a revenue-per-session shock alone is not justification.

execution_order.deliverable: Inventory one site and one acquisition source; define observed/estimated value and identity/grain without sending.
Compare initial signal with mature same-grain net revenue including overlap and revisions.
Shadow-only incremental contribution using existing simulation collector.
After explicit separate approval, validate eligible upload path and later correction with receipts.

evidence_limits: No live Ads, GAM, Prebid, partner or database test in this review.
No monetary gain, IVT reduction or model-latency gain demonstrated.
SDK/API capability is distinct from active account eligibility.

current_repo_evidence.finding: reconciliation and overlapping source checks exist as SQL; this review did not verify deployment
existing autonomy boundaries must not be bypassed
